cpu.description: Maximum CPU the container can use, in cores or millicores.

memory.description: Maximum memory the container can use. The container is killed when it uses more.

additionalProperties.description: Extended resource quantity, keyed by resource name (for example `nvidia.com/gpu`). Rendered as-is.

limits.description: Maximum amount of resources the container can use. Limits are **optional**. Set `cpu` and `memory` to `0` to remove them.

cpu.description: CPU the scheduler reserves for the container, in cores or millicores.

memory.description: Memory the scheduler reserves for the container.

additionalProperties.description: Extended resource quantity, keyed by resource name (for example `ephemeral-storage`). Rendered as-is.

requests.description: Minimum amount of resources the container needs, which the scheduler reserves on a node. Requests are **required**, because without them Kubernetes uses the `limits` as the `requests`.

excludeExtra.description: Leave out the extra resources (for example GPUs) that common adds to this container, so only `cpu` and `memory` are rendered.

description: CPU, memory and extended resources of the container. Overrides the top-level `resources` for this container. See [resources](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/resources).
